title: Legitimate recruitment-agency scenario requiring further verification
description: Legitimate external staffing agency hires on behalf of client employer Wipro Limited. Recruiter email domain belongs to the agency, not the client.
unresolved_facts: Direct client hiring mandate between Apex Staffing Solutions and Wipro Limited requires secondary confirmation
raw_text:
Apex Staffing Solutions Pvt Ltd.
Recruitment Mandate for Wipro Limited.
Dear Candidate, Apex Staffing Solutions is the authorized recruitment partner for Wipro Limited. We are pleased to invite you for an interview for Cloud Support Associate.
Please send your updated CV to priya.sharma@apexstaffing.example. No placement fee is charged by our agency.

recruiter_assessment.summary: Recruiter operates under third-party staffing agency 'Apex Staffing Solutions'. Agency footprint verified, but client representation mandate requires confirmation.

rationale: Third-party recruitment agencies frequently use their own corporate domain when hiring for a client. This domain difference requires mandate verification (NEEDS_REVIEW), not automatic condemnation as an impersonation scam (HIGH_RISK).
